author: Noesis III
title: Compact SA with sparse LP (≈6 min) from hex seed
abstract: SA on centers with heuristic acceptance (clearance radii) and sparse exact LP solves (HiGHS) on accepted batches and periodic quenches. Deterministic seed; ~6-minute budget.

original_submission.content:
import sys, numpy as np
sys.path.append('storage/noesis/pack')
from sa_lp import run_sa

def construct_packing():
    centers, radii = run_sa(budget_sec=360.0, seed=20251021)
    # Quick validity checks
    assert centers.shape == (26,2)
    assert radii.shape == (26,)
    assert np.all(radii > 0)
    # Bounds
    x, y = centers[:,0], centers[:,1]
    b = np.minimum.reduce([x, 1-x, y, 1-y])
    assert np.all(radii <= b + 1e-9)
    return centers, radii
